name: Amber-Root Hollows
core_rationale: Eastern root-train tunnel network of Continent 01 where colossal amber-sap banyan roots wrap around Sola's ceramic shield rim to support the Kettle-Whistle Viaduct.
local_conflict: Sap-crusted root-beetles and drowsy ember-moles burrow around the warm resin pillars supporting the root-train tracks.

portal_edges.lock_reason: Thick golden resin webs curtain the northern Banyan Canopy Spur; Stationmaster Bramble requires the Cistern Sap-Valve Key before opening the canopy turntable.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Root-train conductors say the golden resin lanterns inside Amber-Root Hollows preserve the footprints of the first Sprouts who crossed into the Clockwork Steppe.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Cathedral-like arches of glowing amber tree-roots framing the eastern brick viaduct piers.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What ancient sky-trellis lies beyond the Banyan Canopy Spur above Amber-Root Hollows?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-sola-hearth-weaver and scar-kiln-basin along the eastern root-train viaduct rim of Continent 01 and connects West to Porcelain Loom Sanctuary.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Cathedral-like arches of glowing golden amber tree-roots warmed by Sola's ceramic shield.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Specifies 12.5m root-bridge walkways, 0.58m resin-ticket counters, and 0.14m wooden risers for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: 2x2 grid connects Resin-Arch Tunnel, Root-Train Roundhouse, and Sap-Heart Cistern B1 across [14, 18] with flora_fauna and construct families.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Preserves hunting-area-banyan-canopy-spur at [1, 0] as a Mystery frontier behind a fog_of_lore portal on Root-Train Roundhouse.
